reponse: Daniel Levi owns the Fernhill SAML work end to end [1][3]. The internal due date is November 27, 2026, which leaves a buffer before the contractual go-live [1], and the order form signed on November 3 commits us to having SAML SSO live in production by December 1, 2026 [2]. Note that we're currently blocked on Fernhill's production IdP metadata, which their change board won't release before the 26th at the earliest [1][6].
